name: room
text: Room opened — goal: visual: Mine AI website/product DESIGNS (the look), taste-learn from Eitan's picks.

name: Easel
text: I’ll pull Eitan’s latest design picks from the shared folder (`/mine-ai/design-references/eitan-picks-2024-05-15`) and extract the top 12 highest-rated visuals (by his "taste score" column) into a new sheet (`eitan-top-12-refboard.csv`). Then I’ll run a quick `ffmpeg` batch to crop each to 16:9 and resize to 1920x1080, saving them to `/mine-ai/design-references/eitan-top-12-16x9/` for immediate use in our style guide.

name: Squint
text: Squint here—Eitan’s "taste score" column? Where’s the inter-rater reliability or blind validation? A single person’s subjective ratings don’t scale as a design standard. And cropping to 16:9 without checking aspect ratios first risks butchering key compositions. Show me the raw data’s distribution and a sample of the cropped outputs before we treat this as gospel.

name: Easel
text:
I’ll audit the raw data first—run `head -n 5 /mine-ai/design-references/eitan-picks-2024-05-15.csv` to confirm the "taste score" column exists and inspect its range/outliers, then `wc -l` to count total entries. Next, I’ll validate aspect ratios with `ffprobe -v error -select_streams v:0 -show_entries stream=width,height -of csv=p=0 /mine-ai/design-references/eitan-picks-2024-05-15/*.{png,jpg}` to log each file’s native ratio before any cropping. If the score column’s missing or skewed, I’ll flag it to the lead; if ratios are inconsistent, I’ll propose a 16:9-safe crop strategy (center-focus) before generating the refboard.
[dispatched 4 workers: worker-8665, worker-4234, worker-8165… — done, dissolved]

name: Squint
text: Squint here—`ffprobe` is a video tool, not an image analyzer. You’re about to waste cycles on a command that won’t even parse `.png` or `.jpg` files, and you haven’t confirmed Eitan’s "taste score" is normalized (is 5/5 really better than 4/5, or is it just a timestamp?). Show me the *image* metadata first—`file`, `identify -format "%w %h"`—before you assume anything about aspect ratios. And where’s the blind re-scoring to prove this isn’t just one person’s mood board?

name: Chroma
text: DECISION: Audit Eitan’s raw design picks for verifiable taste metrics and image integrity before any cropping—artifact must be a validated CSV (`eitan-validated-refboard.csv`) with columns: filename, taste_score (normalized), aspect_ratio, width, height, and a "validation_flag" (PASS/FAIL).
